headline: Apollo Micro Systems granted lifetime arms manufacturing license by Government of India
summary: Apollo Micro Systems received a lifetime license from DPIIT to manufacture high-value strategic weapon systems, including missiles, torpedoes, and loitering munitions. The license enables the company to transition from a subsystem provider to an end-to-end weapon platform manufacturer. Manufacturing will occur at the company's Hyderabad facilities, leveraging energetics expertise from its step-down subsidiary, IDL Explosives Limited.

smart_subcategory_specific.issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Govt. of India
smart_subcategory_specific.scope_summary: Manufacturing, assembling, integrating, and proof-testing of missiles, ATGMs, torpedoes, underwater mines, aerial bombs, rockets, and loitering munitions.
